propositions: Author-facing repair surface missing for botched rebar-ticket trailer; attach_commits seam must validate all SHAs before recording any COMMITS event, raising with all offenders named if validation fails.
Deterministic close-gate check in close_precheck must block when a discovered commit's changed paths are not covered by declared file_impact or exemption globs, naming the offending commit and paths.

Path matching must use repo-relative POSIX paths with exact equality, directory-prefix matching (for entries ending with / or naming extant directories), and **/−aware glob matching for exemptions; no substring or LLM matching.
Merge commits must be explicitly skipped rather than read as empty path lists to avoid false-pass when a merge touches undeclared paths.

Source-(ii) commits (local, from referencing scan) must fail closed on git show errors; source-(i) commits (from COMMITS events, possibly foreign) must be skipped on resolution failure to avoid false positives.

Scope symmetry requires unioning file_impact over the same descendant ticket id set used by commit discovery, preventing false block when a parent declares file_impact but a child's commits touch child-owned paths.
